about: The one fight V3 plays: the first career fight of a frankendom.com page load at 82a994d15 (V1 main.ts + match.ts begin('career')): the Centurion at the Match's default level (PRESET_LEVEL.normal = level-anchor-defs.json normal, 18: V1 only moves to the career level on a rematch, and a rematch that changes his loadout reloads the page, so a guest always meets him at 18 with the gladius and scutum), met at a guest's tier (Recruit), the Match's default seed, the longsword, SPECIAL 1/2 from career-rules.json betaCut slot defaults, specials on (rows80 specialsFromLevel 1), the default stance pick (stance.ts PICKS[0]). Rematch steps the seed as V1 nextSeed does. tempoHz: V1's default tempo (main.ts TEMPO_KEY). frameDtMaxS: the most one frame injects into the sim (V1 first-loss-rules.json frame-dt-max-s). gfx: V1's gfx lift (fx-rows gfx.default on). Dom 2026-10-26 (later): the opponent keeps the Minotaur's look but fights as V1's Pitborn (`opponent`): the Pitborn's moves, cleaver (at every level), stats, AI profile under the `ai` brain row and class special (Earth Fold at 18), no shield and no shield-bearer block; the same level, seed and picks. ?pitborn=v1 (and ?foe=v1) = the Centurion's fight above exactly (`opponentV1`, src/fight/foe-pick.ts).

opponentV1.about: ?pitborn=v1 (and ?foe=v1, the Centurion exactly): the opponent before Dom's 2026-10-26 Pitborn call, the Centurion at `level` (gladius + scutum), drawn as the Minotaur with the Cleaver over his gladius (`foeWeapon`) and no shield (src/fight/foe-body.ts). Gate 0's V1-vs-V3 configs are pinned to him (test/gate0/configs.json).

camera.about: V2's lower, over-the-shoulder fight camera on V1's lock (src/fight/camera.ts setLockFrame; ?cam=v1 = V1's lock exactly). V2 (Frankendom-v2 data/camera.json portrait: back 6.5, up 2.8, side 1.0, zoom 0.9) puts the eye ~2.8 m up and 1.0 m over the right shoulder; V1's lock at a 2.5 m gap is 4.2 m up (max(lockLiftFloor 3.2, gap x 1.3) x fightBack 1.3) and 5.7 m back. lift scales V1's lock height (2.8 / 4.2); side is V2's shoulder step in metres. A finish eases both back to V1's lock, as V1 does fightBack.

guardWalk.about: V2 #48 (Dom: 'guarding then backing off floats'): moving with a guard held, the legs keep walking. The tracks of these bones (V1's warrior and Centurion rigs) come from the armed walk/strafe/run clips, every other bone from Guard (src/fight/characters.ts setGuardWalk). ?guard=v1 = V1's whole-body Guard clip.

specialPace.about: Dom 2026-10-26 after playing: 'the skull crack is good, but it's a bit slowed down ... maybe 25% faster. The whirlwind speed is fine.' The player's SKULL CRACK (SPECIAL 1, skill cleave) runs at `scale` of its V1 ticks, each rounded to the nearest tick (src/fight/special-pace.ts): committed windup 32 -> 24 (sandbox specialMeleeWindup), no-attack recovery after the strike 45 -> 34 (rules special.recovery), the clip's raise and return read over 120 -> 90 and 45 -> 34 so the Special_SkullCrack clip plays the same span 4/3 faster, the start whoosh 280 -> 210 ms. Damage, reach, cooldown and the cast pushback are unchanged. The Whirlwind (SPECIAL 2) and every opponent special keep V1's timing. ?skull=v1 = today's timing.

start.about: Dom 2026-10-26 ('remove the start button… The game just starts'): no Fight press. On the first tick the fight runs (art in), the driver gives a sheathed hero V1's draw press itself (src/auto-start.ts); the sim and its 42-tick draw are V1's, the opponent engages when the draw ends, and a Rematch starts the same way. The STRIKE button is the light attack from the first frame. ?start=v1 = V1's Fight button (the first press draws).

trail.about: Dom 2026-10-26 on his phone: the swing's pale blade trail is 'a bit too much ... maybe half of that' on the cuts, and the stab 'about 30%' less. The swing trail (src/fight/characters.ts, one cream ribbon at opacity 0.12, normal blending, the same on both fighters) draws at 0.12 x this row's number for the clip key the swing plays (src/fight/trail-opacity.ts): the cuts (light = light_right and heavy_right, return = light_left and its chain and heavy_left, heavy = the overhead, slashRiposte) at 0.5, the stab (thrust = thrust, chained thrust and heavy_thrust; riposte, a thrust) at 0.7. Both fighters, visual only. A melee special's own trail (sandbox specialTrail rows) and the Pommel Strike keep theirs. ?trail=v1 = today's trail.

specialTerms.about: Dom 2026-10-26 (via Lead): 'Specials, all of them, can be used every 9 seconds, no stamina cost.' The HERO's specials (SPECIAL 1 the Skull Crack, SPECIAL 2 the Whirlwind, and a plain skill if the hero carries one) cool for `cooldown` ticks (540 = 9 s at 60 Hz), counted as today (the Skull Crack from the strike's release, the Whirlwind from the press), and cost and need `stamina` (0) instead of their move row's (the Whirlwind's 40). Kept: the first special ready 2 s in (rows80 first), the Skull Crack's 2.2 m reach and its no-attack recovery after the strike, exhaustion (an empty bar still refuses every attack), a spell's own cost. Opponents' specials are unchanged. src/fight/special-terms.ts; off in headless runs (Gate 0). ?spec=v1 = V1's cooldowns (6 s Skull Crack, 15 s Whirlwind) and the Whirlwind's 40 stamina.

readyRing.about: Dom 2026-10-26: 'a thin yellow extra circle around it, not fat, that glows a little when you can use it.' A ring just outside each SPECIAL button (src/fight/hud.ts, src/style.css .ring), fed from the sim's own legality (combat.ts specialReadiness): `colour` and `width` px while ready, with a soft `glow` px halo pulsing over `pulseMs`; while cooling a faint `track` ring fills clockwise with the cooldown; while short of stamina the track is `staminaTrack` (the stamina bar's low red). `gap` px between the button's rim and the ring. ?ring=v1 = today's HUD exactly (no ring, today's dim rules).

foeWeapon.about: Dom 2026-10-26, his pick in OpenTrident's weapon picker (Frankendom → Cleaver): the Minotaur wields V1's plain Cleaver. Lead: a VISUAL weapon only. The sim, the AI and Gate 0 still fight with `weapon` (the gladius: its id, moves, reach, damage and timing) and his scutum stays; the scene draws `drawn` instead (src/fight/foe-weapon.ts): its equip file src/assets/weapons/foe/<drawn>.glb (the gladius's file, same hand socket and clips, V1's Cleaver part in the socket: scripts/foe-body/graft-weapon.mjs) and its rank shape at his rung (public/weapons/shapes/cleaver-plain.glb, V1's file). ?foeweapon=v1 = the gladius on him; ?foe=v1 = the Centurion exactly. Since Dom's later 10-26 call the opponent is the Pitborn, who really fights with the cleaver (the same equip file, grafted over the trident minotaur.glb bakes), so this row, keyed to the Centurion, draws only under ?pitborn=v1.

blendMs.about: PM queue item (a), 'roll blend' (PLAN step-5 list): V2 #70's per-transition blend rows, numbers as they are in Frankendom-v2 data/anim.json blendMs (main 78d19d6; V2 render.js combatOf). V1 (characters.ts) fades a combat clip in over the first 1/12 and out over the last 1/10 of its move whatever the move's length, and eases every clip weight at 24/s. With these rows a combat clip's weight rises over `<kind>In` ms after its move starts and falls over `<kind>Out` ms before it ends: attack (every swing and the kick), special (a special's windup + recovery), hurt (a hit reaction), roll; `locomotion` is the time an eased weight (walk, run, guard, every clip) takes to close ~95% of its gap (V1's 24/s is 125 ms). None above 150 ms (V2's A1 cap). Deaths, finishers, the draw, guard/block/parry/deflect and the live-blade snap keep V1's. Both fighters, visual only (src/fight/anim-blend.ts). ?blend=v1 = V1's transitions exactly.

settleMs.about: V2's one named exception to the 150 ms cap (Frankendom-v2 data/anim.json settleMs, Dom 2026-10-26 on V2: the roll 'suddenly switches to the normal stance'): the roll's weight eases out over this many ms before it ends, in place of blendMs.rollOut, so the roll settles into the stance instead of snapping. V2 set 300 for its 84-tick (1.4 s) roll-to-run, where 300 ms is the last 21 %; V3's roll is V1's 36 ticks (600 ms), where 300 ms is the whole second half and she rose while the sim still had her rolling (Lead 2026-10-26, on PR #35's stills). So 120 here: V2's rollOut, the same ~20 % tail of a 36-tick roll, and recovery reads where the sim recovers. ?blend=v1 = V1's.

bladeTables.about: First-visit weight (docs/V3-OWED-2026-10-26.md: blade-paths.ts was 31 % of main.js). V1's src/fight/blade-paths.ts bakes every (rig, weapon) sweep V1 ships (8 rigs, 18 tables, 413 KB); V3's duel reads only these, measured by instrumenting bladeFrames over npm test + gate0:v3 (2026-10-26): the hero's longsword, the Centurion's gladius (level 18) and his Recruit trident (level < LOADOUT_FROM, Gate 0's level-1 rows). The build (scripts/blade-tables.mjs) bundles only these; the source file stays V1's as copied. test/blade-tables.test.mjs pins that every weapon the fight can reach is listed. Build only: the sim reads the same numbers. 2026-10-26 (Dom's Pitborn call): + the Pitborn's cleaver (rig hero at every level); the gladius and trident stay for ?pitborn=v1 and Gate 0's Centurion configs.

foeReach.about: Dom 2026-10-26 on his phone: the opponent's attacks hurt him from too far away. The Pitborn (`opponent`) fights with V1's hero/cleaver sweeps (src/fight/blade-paths.ts), baked in V1 on another body's clips (V1's veteran-cleaver.glb); the Minotaur he is drawn as plays the Centurion's clips (minotaur.glb), whose drawn cleaver falls 4-10 cm short of them at the active frames (tip 1.04-1.15 m from his root, against V1's 1.10-1.20). By default the sim sweeps the cleaver where the Minotaur draws it: scripts/foe-body/bake-blades.mjs bakes `body`'s own clips with the drawn cleaver (src/assets/weapons/foe/cleaver.glb) in his hand socket, V1's bake exactly otherwise (same clip per path, easing, frame count and frame; its --check re-bakes V1's table from V1's file to the bit), into src/fight/blade-minotaur.ts, laid over V1's table for `rig`/`weapon` only (src/fight/foe-reach.ts). Only for `opponent` drawn in `body`: ?pitborn=v1 (the Centurion, gladius) and ?foe=v1 (V1's bodies) keep V1's sweeps. `?<query>=<v1>` (?reach=v1) = V1's cleaver sweeps exactly (the hero is on V1's sweeps by default already; ?reach=clip still moves only the hero's). The AI's reach rows (weapon-defs / move-defs `reach`, `stepIn`) are V1's, untouched. Gate 0's configs fight the Centurion, so they never read it.
